description: This file defines a utility class `Env` for loading environment variables in a Flutter application. It attempts to load a `.env` configuration from assets or the file system, providing a fallback mechanism to support different runtime environments.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to load environment variables from different sources in a Flutter app.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to load environment variables first from assets, then from the file system, handling errors gracefully without throwing exceptions.

calls: print('Env.load: could not load .env from assets: $e')
